WITH pre_agg AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
        COUNT(ss.ss_quantity) AS cnt_quantity,
        SUM(ss.ss_quantity) AS sum_quantity,
        COUNT(ss.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
        COUNT(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
        SUM(ss.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
        COUNT(ss.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price,
        SUM(ss.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price
    FROM store_sales AS ss
    JOIN customer_demographics AS cd ON ss.ss_cdemo_sk = cd.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim AS d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN store AS st ON ss.ss_store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    WHERE cd.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND cd.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND cd.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
      AND d.d_year = 1999
      AND st.s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_store_sk
)
SELECT i.i_item_id, st.s_state, 0 AS g_state,
       SUM(pa.sum_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(pa.sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(pa.sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(pa.sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM pre_agg AS pa
JOIN item AS i ON pa.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
JOIN store AS st ON pa.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id, st.s_state
UNION ALL
SELECT i.i_item_id, NULL::character(2) AS s_state, 1 AS g_state,
       SUM(pa.sum_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(pa.sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(pa.sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(pa.sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM pre_agg AS pa
JOIN item AS i ON pa.item_sk = i.i_item_sk
GROUP BY i.i_item_id
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::character(16) AS i_item_id, NULL::character(2) AS s_state, 1 AS g_state,
       SUM(pa.sum_quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_quantity), 0) AS agg1,
       SUM(pa.sum_list_price) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_list_price), 0) AS agg2,
       SUM(pa.sum_coupon_amt) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_coupon_amt), 0) AS agg3,
       SUM(pa.sum_sales_price) / NULLIF(SUM(pa.cnt_sales_price), 0) AS agg4
FROM pre_agg AS pa
ORDER BY i_item_id, s_state
LIMIT 100
